svg.text: 1 page · light + dark · dashed strips are mock annotations, not product UI

g.title: CRW-02-light — New Change Request — operable form (light)
g.desc: /t/acme/changes/new · one scrolling form: PR-URL resolution to exact commits, add/edit/remove/repair subjects, add/edit/remove Claims and Verifiers with mode selection and billable warning, editable owners, Save draft always

g.text: One scrolling form — never a wizard. Save an incomplete draft at any point.
Raise checkout ranking cutoff for high-risk carts
High-risk carts are captured too readily — hold borderline carts for review instead of capturing them.
held carts rise ~0.6% → ~2.2% · capture errors fall — editable, shown to every reviewer
one or more · exact base → candidate commits are the identity
LINK A PULL REQUEST — RESOLVES TO EXACT COMMITS
the URL is convenience, never identity
✕ acme/ranking has no candidate commit — repair from the PR URL or enter the exact commit. The draft still saves.
no branch is ever an identity
3 Claims · every requirement and mode is a control
Checkout stays correct for high-risk carts
No new personal data leaves checkout
Two selected Verifiers charge per run. On new evidence can start a paid run without further confirmation.
Every section is on this one scrolling page.
Not available here — no upload or acceptance before
a revision and one exact subject have been resolved.

svg.text: CRW-02 — New Change Request route: /t/acme/changes/new params: none pattern: R-FORM

states: PR URL resolves to repository · provider · PR · exact base/candidate (URL is convenience, never identity); one repairable invalid subject with inline error; Required/Mode selects; billable warning beside the modes; Evidence earned-absent; Save draft never hides
links: Save draft → /changes/change_06; Resolve → subject preview; verifier → /cards/card_verifier_01; Discard → /changes
